mentions.name: RateRudder
mentions.description: RateRudder automates home solar and battery usage to arbitrage electricity market prices, strategically planning when to use, conserve, or charge the battery to save $1+ per day on real-time or time-of-use utility plans. It currently supports a few utility providers and FranklinWH batteries, with Powerwall and other ESS support sought, and is open-source on GitHub.
mentions.problem: Home batteries are underutilized under time-varying electricity pricing, so owners miss out on savings from strategically timing battery charge and discharge.
mentions.audience: Homeowners with solar and home battery systems on real-time or time-of-use utility plans.
mentions.source_excerpt:
RateRudder: https://raterudder.com

I've been working on a solution to automate solar+battery use to arbitrage the market. I'm on a real-time utility plan but even if you're on TOU it can save you $1+ per day by strategically planning when to use the battery and when to conserve or charge the battery. So far it's limited to a few providers and only FranklinWH batteries but I'm eagerly looking for someone to help me get Powerwall support working and other ESS. It's open-source on GitHub as well.
